closureNotes: Scope item 1 (verify by facts): .claude/hooks/session-root-assert.mjs now verifies three measured facts - the folder is a git work tree of Pootytxng/sentinel, Work Control's `Worktree / branch` field names it for an issue and the live branch is the board's branch for that issue, and no live competing writer holds it. The launch token is not an input to any pass or any refusal; writer-contention.test.mjs pins that mechanically by extracting every refuse("CODE") literal from the hook source and asserting SESSION_FOREIGN, LAUNCH_SPENT and NO_TOKEN are not among them.

Scope item 2 (record the claiming pid, treat a dead process as lapsed): the per-folder record is now a WRITER LEASE carrying sessionId + pid. livenessOf reads two signals - the pid may only PROMOTE a lease to live, the transcript under ~/.claude/projects/*/<sessionId>.jsonl is what CONDEMNS - giving "none"/"live"/"dead"/"unknown". A dead holder lapses and is taken over with the takeover disclosed in a note; unknown still locks the folder, per collision rule 4.

Scope item 3 (any Claude tab in the right folder verifies without a launch token): proven live, not asserted. This session is exactly the class #216 is about - a tab the launcher did not name, in the folder the dead launcher session 8fc927ae held - and verifySession returns ok, mode resume, issue 215.

Scope item 4 (launcher kept for worktree creation only): launch.mjs still creates the worktree, posts the claim, writes the brief and starts the window. Its token survives as an internal handshake for the ide-bridge nonce and the brief digest and admits nobody. One addition the rebuild required: launch.mjs now clears the 10-minute board cache immediately after posting the claim, or the session it starts seconds later would read its own brand-new worktree as unclaimed - guarded in writer-contention.test.mjs by asserting the invalidate call sits after the claim and before the window start.

Scope item 5 (guard it in tools/entry/writer-contention.test.mjs): 54 tests in that file, covering the #216 lockout directly (a foreign DEAD lease no longer refuses; a foreign LIVE one still does), each of the three facts as load-bearing, adopt's half of the same rule, the two liveness probes measured against the real machine, and the duplicated `Worktree / branch` grammar pinned equal to tools/entry/worktree-field.mjs.

TWO JUDGMENT CALLS, both deliberate, both reported to the owner in chat rather than buried: (a) the launch token FILE was demoted, not deleted - removing it would have meant redesigning launch.mjs and ide-bridge.mjs in the same change; (b) the context-window check is now a recorded note instead of a refusal, because a tab the owner opens himself has whatever window it has and refusing it would rebuild the lockout this issue is about.
